paragraphs: I'm applying for the Finance & Accounting internship at Citadel. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, with work experience at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The fund and broker-dealer accounting and financial reporting placements interest me most, because they would show me how an investment firm's books, NAVs and financial statements come together.

At Thomson Reuters I worked in order management and financial operations. I handled cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows, ran reconciliations with 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting, and supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region. In my MBA coursework I prepared core financial statements from underlying transactions and analyzed statements and disclosures to assess earnings quality across firms.

That background fits the close, reporting and review work your team describes. I'm strong in Excel, careful with detail, and happy to keep at a process until it is right. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the program.
